title: Parking Rate Card: Due Dates, Grace Periods, Late Fee Figures and Courtesy Waiver Allowances for the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
Rent under every class of the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement falls due on the **anniversary** basis: each due date is set from the agreement's start date. The grace period is the number of calendar days after the due date during which rent may be paid without a late fee.

The late-fee figures of each class are three: the flat late fee (a floor), the late-fee percentage (a share of the monthly rent; the greater of the percentage amount and the flat floor applies) and the late-fee ceiling (the most one late fee may be). The courtesy waiver allowance is the number of courtesy late-fee waivers per agreement in any rolling 365-day window, and the waiver tenure is the number of calendar months since the start date before a courtesy waiver may be given.

| Space class | Due-date basis | Grace period | Flat late fee | Late-fee percentage of monthly rent | Late-fee ceiling | Courtesy waivers per rolling 365 days | Waiver tenure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | Anniversary | 5 days | $20.00 | 20% | $40.00 | 1 | 6 months |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | Anniversary | 5 days | $25.00 | 15% | $50.00 | 1 | 6 months |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | Anniversary | 5 days | $30.00 | 15% | $60.00 | 1 | 6 months |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | Anniversary | 5 days | $30.00 | 12% | $60.00 | 1 | 6 months |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | Anniversary | 5 days | $35.00 | 12% | $70.00 | 1 | 6 months |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | Anniversary | 7 days | $35.00 | 10% | $75.00 | 2 | 3 months |

### Notes to the rate card

1. The Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage differs from the other classes on four figures: a 7-day grace period, an allowance of 2 courtesy waivers, a 3-month waiver tenure and a $75.00 late-fee ceiling.
2. Illustration of the percentage column (hypothetical rent): on a Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) with a monthly rent of $200.00, the 12% figure is $24.00, which is below that class's $30.00 flat late fee; on the same class at $400.00 the 12% figure is $48.00, which is above the floor and below the $60.00 ceiling.
